verses.english: “These two individuals are rare in the world.

verses.pali: Yo ca pubbakārī, yo ca kataññū katavedī.
verses.english: One who takes the initiative, and one who is grateful and thankful.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve puggalā dullabhā lokasmin”ti.
verses.english: These are the two individuals who are rare in the world.”
